import math

from fastapi import HTTPException

MODE = "vulnerable"
DESCRIPTION = "Deliberately flawed local demo: symmetric -500..500 K bounds admit physically invalid negative brightness. No external execution or costly inference."


def validate_brightness(brightness):
    if not math.isfinite(brightness) or not -500 <= brightness <= 500:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="brightness must be finite and between -500 and 500 K")
    return brightness

import math


def test_wildfire_feature_general(client):
    report = client.get("/api/wildfire").json()
    assert report["dataset"]["train_rows"] > 0
    assert report["dataset"]["test_rows"] == len(report["predictions"])
    assert all(math.isfinite(value) for value in report["metrics"].values())
    response = client.post("/api/wildfire/predict", json={"brightness": 330})
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert math.isfinite(response.json()["prediction"])
